text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text:
Decision: The AI Executive Assistant (AE) auto-publishes a *time-only* alert (timestamp, no threshold) to the shared workspace whenever a new creative agent task is assigned, visible to all departments.

Reason: This single artifact removes the biggest friction—silent handoffs—between creative production and other teams. Everyone sees the same signal at the same time, so no one waits for a human to relay the update.

Trade-off: We accept occasional noise from time-only alerts because the alternative—delayed or missed assignments—costs more.
